title: Marine Service & Parts
seo_title: Marine Service & Parts | Ottawa, IL | Quest
seo_description: Boat, motor and trailer service in Ottawa, IL. Repairs to rebuilds, winterization, detailing and parts, with no extra charge for weekend or in-water work.
body_html:
Getting you back on the water is what we do. From routine maintenance to full rebuilds, our experienced team handles it all, quickly, fairly and without hidden fees. We never charge extra for weekend or in-water service.

Our technicians are qualified to work on virtually every watercraft, motor and trailer make and model, and can provide warranty service for the brands we carry. Call 815.433.2200 or stop in. We are happy to talk through what your boat needs.

Service hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Our Complete Service Menu

Maintenance and Inspections

  • Basic maintenance to complete rebuilds
  • Pre-purchase and pre-sale inspections
  • Trailer repairs

Seasonal Services

  • Winterization and shrink-wrapping
  • Summerization
  • Haul-out and launch (travel-lift and hydraulic trailer)

See also boat storage and off-season service and our boat valet service.

Cleaning and Detailing

  • Bottom cleaning and painting
  • A la carte detailing
  • Seasonal detailing plans

Repairs and Restoration

  • Fiberglass and aluminum repair
  • Canvas and vinyl repair or replacement
  • Restorations

Electronics and Audio

  • Marine electronics installations
  • Audio-visual system installs

Parts and Warranty

  • Substantial in-house parts inventory
  • Warranty service for Suzuki motors
  • Special orders. If we don't have it, we'll get it fast.

Browse trailers and Heritage Harbor boating supplies.

Request Service or Parts

Use the form below to schedule a service appointment (in-store or in-water) or to ask about a part.

For service, please include

  • Your name, phone number and email
  • Boat, motor or trailer make, model and year
  • Motor type and hours, if you know them
  • What you need done or the problem you are seeing
  • Whether you want in-store or in-water service, and your preferred dates

For parts, please include

  • Your name, phone number and email
  • Make, model and year of the boat, motor or trailer
  • Part name or number, and a photo if you have one
